name: notebooklm-login-service
description: Free, self-hosted companion service: runs Chrome in a virtual display (Xvfb) inside its own Docker container, exposes it via noVNC for an embeddable iframe (works on iPad Safari), and reads the resulting NotebookLM login cookies via CDP once the user finishes logging in. Only runs during an explicit user-initiated 'Connect NotebookLM' action.
